_README: Persistent record of vendors a price-pull run could NOT write, so a later run reports 'skipped last week, still broken' instead of rediscovering it. Keyed by vendor slug. category ∈ {vendor-broken, walled, incomplete-pull, transient, currency, permanent, pin-loss}. first_seen/last_seen are ISO dates (ET). recheck = whether the next run should retry (transient/walled) or leave it (permanent/currency until the vendor changes). Update last_seen each run the skip persists; remove an entry the run the vendor writes cleanly again. NOTE: amino-club is deliberately NOT here — its blend [nototal] drop was OURS (blend_total name-only fallback), fixed 2026-08-16, not a vendor skip. HOW IT WAS FOUND (record 2026-08-16): the blend_total gap had been silently dropping ~35 blend rows across 10 vendors for an unknown time. It surfaced ONLY because amino-club was PINNED (vendor-pins) on GLOW/KLOW/Wolverine — its re-pull dropped those blends and check:vendor-pins FAILED loudly. Without that pin the drop stays silent (a WARN-only blend counter). Takeaway: a vendor pin has DIAGNOSTIC value beyond placement — it turns a silent per-vendor data loss into a hard build failure. Worth keeping pins on compounds we care about partly for that trip-wire effect.

purerawz.reason: Live catalog degraded: 42 of 53 products show price $0 with zero variations (kept empty Form/Strength attribute shells); only 11 priced. Row-drop floor REFUSED the write (145 → 18 singles, -83%).

behemoth-labz.reason: Cloudflare bot-challenge turned on — API and homepage both 403 (cf-mitigated: challenge); 'Just a moment…' even in a JS browser. Storefront browsable by a human, not by tooling. Needs a browser pull or a paste. Was pullable before 2026-08-16.

la-peptides.reason: Cloudflare WAF on the /wp-json path only (401); domain lapeptides.net homepage returns 200 and is browsable. API-walled, storefront public. Needs a browser pull or a paste. Was pullable before 2026-08-16.

swiss-chems.reason: IncompletePull guard refused: 9 of 117 variation-page fetches failed all retries. A broken fetch, not a catalog change — retry next run; --allow-shrink does NOT override this.

purerx-peptides.reason: HTTP 503 Service Unavailable on the Store API. Likely transient — retry next run.

nova-labs.reason: Store API reports AED, not USD. PP prices in USD only, so this vendor is unpriceable without an FX policy. Structural, not transient — leave until the vendor sells in USD.

aero-peptides.reason: Store API Cloudflare-walled (adapter:cinc — refresh.py SKIPS it), but the storefront is browsable. REFRESHES VIA CINC BROWSER-READ, not auto-pull: read aeropeptides.com/products in-browser, overwrite scripts/price-pull/fixtures/aero-peptides.cinc.json, run `python3 scripts/price-pull/load_cinc.py --vendor aero-peptides --write [--allow-shrink]`. Last read 2026-08-17 (25 compounds). Next weekend's run must route Aero here, not to refresh.py.
